landing.title: Ship social intelligence as a realtime API, not a custom pipeline.
landing.subtitle: Xentries turns provider events into one normalized contract. Search instantly, promote to monitors, stream results to WebSocket and signed webhooks.

search.title: Instant Search
search.desc: Run pull-style queries in seconds and validate traffic before creating monitors.

monitors.title: Always-on Monitors
monitors.desc: Convert winning queries into durable monitors with dedupe, cursoring and tenant isolation.

delivery.title: Realtime Delivery
delivery.desc: Deliver structured events via WebSocket and HMAC-signed webhooks with retries.

step1.title: Search
step1.desc: Probe hashtag, mention and keyword demand before you commit to a monitor.

step2.title: Monitor
step2.desc: Choose provider, event types and interval. Xentries handles polling and dedupe.

step3.title: Deliver
step3.desc: Fan out events to your app stack through API, WebSocket, or webhook endpoints.

snippet.label: Developer-first
snippet.title: One stream client. Unified event contract.
snippet.desc: Designed for infra teams that need speed today and multi-provider scale tomorrow.

pricing.title: Clear pricing in USD
pricing.subtitle: Start in minutes, scale as throughput grows. No hidden overage traps.
pricing.paymentHint: Checkout integration will support Lemon Squeezy or Paddle in the next phase.

q1.title: Can I start without OAuth?
q1.desc: Yes. MVP runs in public mode with server-managed provider tokens.

q2.title: What happens on provider 401/403?
q2.desc: You get standardized provider errors and status checks without exposing secrets.

q3.title: Can we switch plans later?
q3.desc: Yes. Plan changes are designed to be instant and non-breaking for existing monitors.
